title: The Rain of Terror
author: Jamiroquai
content: A routine Monday dismissal turned into pure chaos on August 31 as severe weather suddenly slammed the J.P. Taravella High School campus. Heavy rain quickly saturated the grounds, causing localized flooding along nearby sidewalks and roadways while continuous, intense thunder sent shockwaves through the crowded crowd of students waiting outside.

As the weather intensified, school administration moved students indoors to the cafeteria at 3:05 PM to wait out the worst of the storm. The scene inside remained hectic as thunder continued to rattle the building, and safety concerns escalated further around 3:30 PM when a car in the pick-up line began smoking amidst the heavy traffic.
Despite the sudden flooding, loud thunder, and vehicle issues outside, students remained indoors until conditions cleared enough for safe travel home.
